text:
Which statement describes how oxides of nitrogen are formed in a car engine?
A
Nitrogen from the air reacts with oxygen from petrol.
B
Nitrogen from the air reacts with oxygen from the air.
C
Nitrogen from petrol reacts with oxygen from petrol.
D
Nitrogen from petrol reacts with oxygen from the air.

options.label: A
options.text: Nitrogen from the air reacts with oxygen from petrol.

options.label: B
options.text: Nitrogen from the air reacts with oxygen from the air.

options.label: C
options.text: Nitrogen from petrol reacts with oxygen from petrol.

options.label: D
options.text: Nitrogen from petrol reacts with oxygen from the air.
